outcome: Attitudes and opinions towards outpatient cervical ripening
Willingness to undergo outpatient cervical ripening
cohort: The study participants were women attending an Australian tertiary hospital's labour and birth suite for a booked induction of labour.
finding: One-third (33%) of patients expressed willingness to undergo outpatient cervical ripening both before the procedure and after delivery.
cross-section timing: During a three-month period, with attitudes assessed before cervical ripening and after delivery.
